notebooks.title: 实验1：坐标、时间与缺失掩码

cells.code:
camera_mm = 94
base_mm = camera_mm + 10
decision_s, captured_s, arrived_s = 1.0, 0.8, 0.95
age_s = decision_s - captured_s
future_arrival_s = 1.02
speed_mm_s = 20
print(f"基座坐标={base_mm:.1f} mm；可用={arrived_s <= decision_s}")
print(f"年龄={age_s:.2f} s；旧帧位移偏差={-speed_mm_s*age_s:.1f} mm")
print(f"未来到达帧可用={future_arrival_s <= decision_s}")
# 演示把缺失填充值误作有效测量，权重来自下节算例。
print(f"误用零填充值={0.2*0+0.8*98:.1f} mm；掩码回退={98:.1f} mm")

notebooks.title: 实验2：权重、失败工况与答案复算
notebooks.setupCode: from fractions import Fraction as F

cells.code:
sv2, sp2 = F(16), F(4)
w = sp2 / (sv2 + sp2)
var = w*w*sv2 + (1-w)**2*sp2
frame = w*104 + (1-w)*98
print(f"视觉权重={float(w):.2f}；本体权重={float(1-w):.2f}")
print(f"融合={float(frame):.2f} mm；单帧误差={float(frame-100):.2f} mm；平方={float((frame-100)**2):.2f} mm^2")
for age in [F(0),F(1,5),F(1,4),F(2,5)]:
    bias = -20*age
    mse = var + (w*bias)**2
    print(f"年龄={float(age):.2f} s；视觉偏差={float(bias):.2f} mm；MSE={float(mse):.2f} mm^2；本体=4.00 mm^2")
correlated = var + 2*w*(1-w)*4*2
print(f"相关系数1、当前帧MSE={float(correlated):.2f} mm^2")
# 闭式阈值：3.2+(0.2*20*age)^2=4
threshold = float((sp2-var)/(w*20)**2)**0.5
print(f"独立误差持平阈值={threshold:.6f} s")
print(f"丢视觉：估计=98.00 mm；MSE=4.00 mm^2")
print(f"仅当前视觉：估计=104.00 mm；MSE=16.00 mm^2")
print("两路缺失：无有效估计；不报告MSE或当前位置")
